harness_runner.raw_utf8:
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / "evidence/quality/functor_shell_pr"
WORK = ROOT / ".venv-review/category-replay"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
WORK.mkdir()
snapshot = WORK / "src/category_theory"
shutil.copytree(ROOT / "code/rust/src/category_theory", snapshot,
                ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("*.contract.score.yaml", "target"))
prior = {}
for name, folder in [("functor", "functor_shell_validation"),
                     ("full_functor", "full_functor_validation")]:
    prior[name] = json.loads((ROOT / f"evidence/quality/{folder}/receipt.json").read_bytes())
manifest = prior["full_functor"]["harness_manifest"]
(WORK / "Cargo.toml").write_text(manifest, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
(WORK / "Cargo.lock").write_text(prior["full_functor"]["dependency_lockfile"],
                                encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
(WORK / "tests").mkdir()
for name, record in prior.items():
    (WORK / f"tests/serde_{name}.rs").write_text(record["serde_boundary_tests"],
                                               encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
sources = {
    f"code/rust/src/category_theory/functor/{name}.rs":
    sha((ROOT / f"code/rust/src/category_theory/functor/{name}.rs").read_bytes())
    for name in prior
}
for p, digest in sources.items():
    raw = (ROOT / p).read_bytes()
    if raw != subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "HEAD:" + p], cwd=ROOT) or b"\r" in raw:
        raise RuntimeError("Replay must bind committed LF blobs")
record = {
    "schema_version": "tfqm.functor-shell-pr-replay.v1",
    "AuthorityEffect": "None",
    "source_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
    "sources": sources,
    "scope": "Complete actual category-library Rust source snapshot compiled via isolated manifest, plus public serde boundary checks. Original category Cargo build hook and optional external workspace packages are not run.",
    "harness_manifest": manifest,
    "dependency_lockfile": (WORK / "Cargo.lock").read_text(),
    "source_snapshot": {
        p.relative_to(snapshot).as_posix(): sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(snapshot.rglob("*.rs"))
    },
    "serde_boundary_tests": {name: r["serde_boundary_tests"] for name, r in prior.items()},
    "tools": {name: subprocess.check_output([name, "--version"], text=True).strip()
              for name in ["cargo", "rustc"]},
    "steps": [], "mutations": [],
    "historical_records": [
        "evidence/quality/functor_shell_validation",
        "evidence/quality/full_functor_validation",
        "evidence/quality/full_functor_validation_attempt1"
    ],
    "limits": [
        "Seventeen selected semantic fault cases only; no exhaustive mutation coverage or mutation percentage.",
        "Earlier invalid and compound recipes remain historical records and are not erased or counted as successful controls.",
        "No functor-law certificate, actual fullness/faithfulness result, scientific status or authority promotion."
    ]
}
def run(argv, name):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    output = result.stdout + result.stderr
    path = OUT / name
    path.write_text(output, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    item = {"argv": argv, "exit_code": result.returncode,
            "log": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), "log_sha256": sha(path.read_bytes())}
    print(name, "exit", result.returncode, flush=True)
    return item, output
base = ["cargo", "test", "--offline", "--locked", "--manifest-path", str(WORK / "Cargo.toml")]
control, output = run(base, "category-tests.log")
record["steps"].append(control)
if control["exit_code"]:
    raise RuntimeError(output)
counts = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r"test result: ok\. (\d+) passed;", output)]
if counts[0] != 494 or sum(counts[1:]) != 7:
    raise RuntimeError("Unexpected test counts: " + repr(counts))
record["tests"] = {"category": counts[0], "serde": sum(counts[1:]), "doctests": 0}
print("Baseline tests:", record["tests"], flush=True)
try:
    for name, old in prior.items():
        assignments = [node for node in ast.parse(old["harness_runner"]["raw_utf8"]).body
                       if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
                       and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "cases"
                               for target in node.targets)]
        if len(assignments) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("Ambiguous historical mutation list")
        cases = ast.literal_eval(assignments[0].value)
        path = snapshot / f"functor/{name}.rs"
        original = path.read_bytes()
        try:
            for fault, needle, replacement, test in cases:
                text = original.decode()
                if text.count(needle) != 1:
                    raise RuntimeError("Nonunique mutation anchor: " + name + "/" + fault)
                path.write_text(text.replace(needle, replacement), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
                result, text = run(base + ["--lib", f"functor::{name}::tests::{test}", "--", "--exact"],
                                   f"mutant-{name}-{fault}.log")
                killed = result["exit_code"] == 101 and "1 failed" in text and "could not compile" not in text
                record["mutations"].append({
                    "source": f"code/rust/src/category_theory/functor/{name}.rs",
                    "id": fault, "needle": needle, "replacement": replacement,
                    "test": test, "outcome": "killed" if killed else "unexpected", **result
                })
                if not killed:
                    raise RuntimeError(text)
        finally:
            path.write_bytes(original)
finally:
    record["working_sources_unchanged"] = all(
        sha((ROOT / p).read_bytes()) == digest for p, digest in sources.items())
    runner = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    record["harness_runner"] = {"sha256": sha(runner), "raw_utf8": runner.decode()}
    (OUT / "replay.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n",
                                    encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
if len(record["mutations"]) != 17:
    raise RuntimeError("Missing mutation cases")
print("Replay passed: 494 category tests, 7 serde tests, 17 selected mutants caught.", flush=True)
